items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And when we'd go to, and Maggie Mineta would tell you, when we'd go to whack up in the morning, we'd have ten dollar gold pieces in there.

ctx.x: What did they have, like a snare drum or... Regular, regular... Snare and bass?

Bass and snare drum, yeah, trap drum and bass drum, too, you see, yeah. And, uh, so from that on, after that, why, they, uh, the district, then they started to have all that blowing instruments, you see. And, uh, there was so much knowledge. You take Harry Parker, Harry Parker 101 Ranch, and, uh, uh, Hunts and Nagels, them was large places. Large dance halls. They had, they had women with, uh, what was employed there, just to sell a beer, you know. Big quarts of beer, and them, them chummies off the ships used to…
Why do they call them chummies? Those are the sailors?
